name: awesome-advent-of-code
desc: A collection of awesome resources related to the yearly Advent of Code challenge.

resources.name: Globals medals overview
resources.desc: - Alternative global leaderboard showing first, second and third places as gold, silver and bronze medals.

resources.name: Scatterplot of first 100
resources.desc: - Scatterplot of the time taken to solve the parts of each puzzle by the first 100 people that solved it.

resources.name: Private Leaderboard Visualiser
resources.desc: - Given a JSON of your private leaderboard data this website will show you graphs of how long each member took to solve parts 1 and 2 of each day.

resources.name: advent-of-code
resources.desc: - Command-line interface to download challenge descriptions and inputs, manage, test and automatically submit solutions. *(Python)*

resources.name: aocdl
resources.desc: - Command-line utility that automatically downloads your personal input file while you read the puzzle description *(Go)*.

resources.name: aocinput
resources.desc: - CLI for getting inputs. Clipboard support. Polite to AoC. Nice help and options. *(Go)*

resources.name: aoc_rb
resources.desc: - A Ruby gem that generates an empty AoC project, and provides command-line tools for fetching input and submitting solutions *(Ruby)*

resources.name: aoc-cli
resources.desc: - Command-line utility that helps solve problems in ruby: it downloads your personal input file, creates the sample source files and benchmarks your solutions *(Ruby)*.

resources.name: AocKt
resources.desc: - A testing library for creating unit tests for AoC solutions with minimal boilerplate. *(Kotlin)*

resources.name: AoCHelper
resources.desc: - NuGet library that simplifies puzzle solving and provides benchmarking *(.NET)*.

resources.name: AdventOfCode.Runner
resources.desc: - NuGet package that automatically provides your puzzles solvers with the input from the AOC site and verifies calculated answers *(.NET / C#)*.

resources.name: aocleaderboard
resources.desc: - get over the 200-member limit for private leaderboards and combine multiple leaderboards in a single page with recalculated scores.

resources.name: advent-of-code-api
resources.desc: - Haskell library for querying AOC prompts, inputs, and leaderboards *(Haskell)*

resources.name: advent-of-code-ocr
resources.desc: - Command line utility and Haskell library for parsing AoC ascii art words *(Haskell)*

resources.name: advent-of-code-ocr
resources.desc: - Python module for parsing AoC ascii art words *(Python)*

resources.name: aoc-agent
resources.desc: - C# source generator that generates: a) tests for your solution logic, b) complete runner that handles input fetching and answer submitting *(.NET)*

resources.name: aoc-ranking
resources.desc: - Show all non-zero score AoC participants in one, global scoreboard. *(Python)*

resources.name: aoc-cli
resources.desc: - Read puzzle descriptions, download input, and submit answers from the comfort of your terminal. *(Rust)*

resources.name: adventofcode-badge
resources.desc: - An interface over Shields.io to facilitate the creation of badges from Advent of Code.

resources.name: @aocjs/cli
resources.desc: - Package for executing solutions with hot reload and data fetching *(JavaScript, TypeScript)*

resources.name: eggnog
resources.desc: - CLI for getting input, directions (with nice colors!), and submitting answers. Caches absolutely everything. *(C)*

resources.name: aoc-badges-action
resources.desc: - A GitHub action for updating various aoc-related badges in your README *(GitHub Action, Python)*

resources.name: advent-readme-stars
resources.desc: - A GitHub action that adds and maintains a table of your AoC progress to your README *(GitHub Action, Python)*

resources.name: aoctimer
resources.desc: - A language-agnostic, multiplatform tool to measure your solution time in relative units, so you can share and compare your results with others.

resources.name: aocrunner
resources.desc: - A fast solutions runner and template generator, with simple CLI, customizable template, simple testing utility, live reload, and adventofcode.com integration. *(JavaScript, TypeScript)*

resources.name: advent-of-code-client
resources.desc: - A Node.js package for fetching inputs, running puzzle challenges and submitting answers to adventofcode.com directly from your JavaScript code. Also includes some commonly used & customizable input transformation functions. *(JavaScript)*

resources.name: advent-of-code-runner
resources.desc: - Node.JS CLI solution generator and runner. Downloads inputs, submits answers, prevents duplicate submissions, measures performance, tracks progress and outputs statistics. *(JavaScript)*

resources.name: AoC-execution-time-table-generator
resources.desc: - A C++20 tool to generate an execution time table for both parts of each AoC day, based on input file with time details.

resources.name: aocf
resources.desc: - A CLI tool (and also, optionally, crate) written in Rust, with a CLI inspired by git. Problem briefs may be displayed in a scrollable ANSI terminal (mostly) faithful to the AoC website.

resources.name: AdventOfCodeAbstractions
resources.desc: - A NuGet package that contains extendable abstractions and generalized helpers to simplify and streamline .NET AoC puzzle solving. *(C#)*

resources.name: aocd
resources.desc: - A template generator and library for solving AoC with Deno that handles input fetching and solution submitting. *(TypeScript / Deno)*

resources.name: advent_of_code_utils
resources.desc: - Input fetcher and boilerplate generator for those solving AoC in Elixir. *(Elixir)*

resources.name: Advent of Code Surveys (Results Dashboard)
resources.desc: - Dashboard with charts and data tables showing the results of the yearly Advent of Code Survey

resources.name: AdventOfCode-CLI
resources.desc: - A Commandline interface written in python to quickly generate boilerplates in different languages and fetching your puzzle input. Also includes customizable templates and measures solution times.

resources.name: aoc-cli
resources.desc: - Command-line utility that helps solve problems in python: it downloads your personal input file, creates the sample source files and makes sure you don't submit answers twice *(Python)*.

resources.name: Golfcoder
resources.desc: - A code golf community leaderboard for adventofcode.com, with a focus on code size. Every name, including variables and functions, is considered as a single token, irrespective of its length. *(Python, Rust, Go, Kotlin, JavaScript, C#, TypeScript, C++, Java, C, Swift, Scala)*

resources.name: aoc-tiles
resources.desc: - A tool which automatically creates a fancy image with solve times for each solved day in your readme as a 5x5 grid. Works as a pre-commit hook or as a CLI *(Python)*.

resources.name: wang-aoc-cli
resources.desc: - A CLI tool for automatically copying boilerplate code, downloading problem statements and inputs, parsing example inputs and solutions from problem statements, testing against example inputs, and submitting. Expects programs to use stdin and stdout to read inputs and write answers. *(Python)*

resources.name: esb
resources.desc: - esb is a CLI tool to help us elves save Christmas for the yearly Advent of Code events. (Thank you, Eric! 😉). This tool fetches puzzle statements and puzzle data, creates language agnostic boilerplate code, test run and submit solutions and builds dashboards. Check out an example repo created using esb! *(Python, Rust, Elixir, Go)*

resources.name: aoc_helper
resources.desc: - aoc_helper is a library and command line tool which can generate templates, fetch puzzle inputs, submit solutions, and even automatically detect the tests! It also comes with a huge library of utility classes, such as fluent interfaces to iterators and lists, grids which can automatically read text, and more. *(Python)*

resources.name: Star Track
resources.desc: - Web-based visualization tool that generates progress tracking charts and comparisons from your private leaderboard JSON data.

resources.name: pysleigh
resources.desc: - pysleigh is a lightweight python runner , collector, templater, submitter and benchmarker for the advent of code. *(Python)*

resources.name: rusty-sleigh
resources.desc: - rusty-sleigh is a lightweight rust runner , collector , template, submitter and benchmarker for the advent of code. It is a rust port for pysleigh *(Rust)*

resources.name: Kodvent
resources.desc: - a Kotlin utility library for competitive programming and Advent of Code challenges, providing efficient data structures, mathematical functions and string algorithms. *(Kotlin)*

resources.name: Breakpoint: coding advent calendars and yearly events
